Best Camera for Kids to Record Vacations 2026

By Dawid Millennium | Updated September 4, 2026

⚡ Quick Answer

For kids, durability is key. The VTech Kidizoom is indestructible but low quality. For better footage, give them an old GoPro Hero 9/10 in a rugged case.

The "Drop Test" Reality

Kids drop things. In sand. In pools. Your $2000 camera is not safe in their hands. We prioritized "cheap to replace" and "rugged."

Top Kid-Friendly Options

🏆 Most Durable: VTech Kidizoom Duo

  • Rubberized bumper
  • Simple UI
  • Very cheap ($40)

👎 Considerations

  • 720p video only
  • Grainy sensor

FAQ

At what age should kids get a camera?

Around 6-7 years old, they start understanding framing and storytelling.

How to protect the lens?

Tempered glass screen protectors work on GoPros too. Buy a "buddy lens" cap.

Should I let them use my phone?

Only if you trust them. Sand in the charging port is a common tragedy.

Best educational value?

Giving them their own camera encourages creativity and observation skills.

Where to store footage?

Get a cheap card reader and let them transfer files to a laptop themselves.
